style.backgroundSystem: one tactile palette-knife pigment-swipe field built from the product's own bullet tone for the opening claim screen; flat #A85C55 silk-rose field for the wearing card and the texture macro; flat #5E2129 deep-wine card for the comparison, the chart, the spec table and the closing screen; flat #F6EFE6 ivory card for the packshot pair and the trust band; no scenery, no gradients, no tiled grid or graph-paper surfaces, no laboratory glassware
style.iconSystem: hairline #BE8F4C rules and leader lines, hollow circular swatch rings with a single-weight outline, one offset solid #A85C55 rectangle behind a photographic card, and one blank seal ring with no legible characters; no filled pictograms, no numbered circles, no curved connector arcs, no magnifier viewports
style.lightingSystem: warm 3000-3400K key from the front-left, generous bounce fill on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding every object, a single controlled specular on the metal collar only, no flare and no cool grey cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm editorial lip-colour commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of silk-rose field #A85C55, deep-wine card #5E2129, aged-brass hairline #BE8F4C and ivory card #F6EFE6; warm 3000-3400K studio light from the front-left with a generous bounce fill and one soft contact shadow grounding every object, a single controlled specular on the metal collar only, no flare and no cool grey cast; one high-contrast serif display family for every heading, sub-label and table cell, Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed at heading 30-36pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt, no dense body text and no mixed fonts; backgrounds are either the palette-knife pigment-swipe field of the product's own bullet tone or a flat #A85C55 / #5E2129 / #F6EFE6 panel, never scenery, never gradients, never tiled grid or graph-paper surfaces; infographic components limited to aged-brass hairline rules and leader lines, hollow circular swatch rings, one offset solid rectangle behind a photographic card and one blank seal ring with no legible characters; the product keeps one identical upright scale, height and collar placement on every screen; all human imagery is a generic nose-to-chin lips crop or a relaxed hand only, with no eyes, no readable identity and real pore texture that is never smoothed; every colour patch, ring and swipe stays a neutral placeholder tone taken from the injected reference product; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no shade numbers or shade names, no invented weights, volumes, durations, scores or certificates.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no cool or grey cast
no mixed fonts and no dense body text
no random backgrounds, scenery, gradients or tiled grid surfaces
no shade numbers, shade names or colour-family wording anywhere on screen
no invented weights, volumes, durations, scores, labs or certificates
no identifiable face, eyes or full portrait in any lip image
style.presentationRules: the product holds one identical upright scale, height and collar placement on every screen; twisting the bullet up and separating the cap are the only staging moves; all human imagery is a generic nose-to-chin lips crop or a relaxed hand only, with no eyes and no readable identity; real pore and lip-line texture is kept and never smoothed; every swatch area is a neutral placeholder tone supplied by the injected reference and is never named or numbered
style.surfaceSystem: matte ivory card #F6EFE6 and matte deep-wine lacquer card #5E2129; the counter for the claim screen is built from palette-knife strokes of the product's own pigment laid over #A85C55; no wood block, no stone slab, no marble, no paper texture
style.typography: one high-contrast serif display family for every heading, sub-label and table cell; Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed; heading 30-36pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt; no dense body text, no handwritten or sans-serif mixing
